summary: OpenAI published a customer case study describing how Asana used Codex coding agents to remove an outdated testing framework from its codebase in about two weeks for roughly $12K, versus a prior five-year, $6M staffing estimate.

practices.reason: The case study describes a specific parallel-agent prompting setup used by one customer, but the method is under-specified and tied to Asana's own codebase rather than a transferable technique.
practices.quote: From a five-sentence prompt, up to four coding agents worked in parallel, each in a separate copy of the codebase.
